data.narrative:
Re:Build Manufacturing is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Miles Arnone, Jeff Wilke, Anthony Manzo, and Michael Foley that has raised $545M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private peers at Series A and B stages—including Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics—plus one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the company's $545M total raised as a base proxy and applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier moving from Series A to the next financing stage, implying a valuation of $1.1B. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector comparables across adjacent stages (Series A and B), yielding a median valuation of $1.6B with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. The peer set reflects the concentration of capital in robotics-focused founders and the stage heterogeneity typical of the frontier-tech landscape.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $926M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.4B. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-progression multiple for this capital-intensive sector, whether adjacent-stage peers remain sufficiently comparable given Re:Build's specific technical position, and the relevance of limited public market data (one ticker) to private-company valuation in this nascent category.
